response.sql: WITH qualifying AS (SELECT DISTINCT l.ID FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.`U-PRO` IS NOT NULL AND l.`U-PRO` <> '-'), per_patient AS (SELECT l.ID, AVG(l.PT) AS avg_pt, AVG(l.ALP * 1.0 / l.GPT) AS avg_ratio FROM Laboratory l JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = l.ID WHERE l.ID IN (SELECT ID FROM qualifying) GROUP BY l.ID) SELECT TRIM(COALESCE(p.SEX, '')) AS SEX, AVG(pp.avg_pt) AS avg_PT, AVG(pp.avg_ratio) AS avg_ALP_GPT_ratio FROM per_patient pp JOIN Patient p ON p.ID = pp.ID GROUP BY TRIM(COALESCE(p.SEX, ''));
